fact: The May 2025 WAPIS newsletter says the Centre de traitement des informations policières (CTIP), visited by INTERPOL's Secretary General on 18-19 February 2025, is Côte d'Ivoire's DACORE, set up under the European Union-financed SIPAO programme, and that Côte d'Ivoire is among the countries that have begun to feed INTERPOL's databases through SIPAO; it says nothing of what stations enter.
title: SIPAO Lettre d'information, numéro 27, mai 2025
